Context: 9. Check-list of documents for the cases requiring relaxation

## 9. Check-list of documents for the cases requiring relaxation  
- (i) The case should be referred to this Ministry with the specific recommendations of the concerned Joint Secretary/Hoo of the concerned Ministry/ Department along with all supporting documents.
- (ii) Justification for full reimbursement along with the details of the patient including name of the patient, Beneficiary ID, a copy of the CG HS card and name of primary card holder (if other than patient).
